newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHISPANK H1 PROFIT 57.7 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: UHISPANK H1 PROFIT 57.7 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Uhispank said on Friday that its profit in June came to 8.5 million kroons for a total first-half profit of 57.7 million kroons.

It said in a statement that the June profit was slightly lower than the nine million kroons registered in May due to more provisions of six million kroons on loans taken by North Estonian Bank, which it recently took over.
Uhispank said that its assets were 6.74 billion kroons at the end of June, growth of 87.8 percent over the first six months of the year.

The bank's interest income over the first six months was 239.83 million kroons versus 133.08 million kroons in the first half of 1996 and interest expenses were 104.27 million kroons versus 45.54 million kroons.
Commission payments received were 52.45 million kroons versus 24.49 million kroons and commissions paid came to 16.84 million kroons versus 6.8 million kroons.
Income from financial operations came to 50.04 million kroons versus 15.36 million kroons.
